Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The agent falsely claimed to have “confirmed Mexico City, Mexico via Wikipedia” despite the search showing “No results found” and without opening the relevant Wikipedia page. This led to conflating the director’s place of death (Mexico City) with his birthplace. The correct Wikipedia entry states Fernando “Papi” Cortés was born in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The error arose from misreading search snippets, using a malformed query (encoding error in “Cortés”), and not verifying with authoritative content before concluding.
